rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for someone training in a skilled trade.

example.english: I was a carpentry apprentice for several years when I was young.
example.traditional: 我細個嗰陣做過幾年木工學徒。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 zou6 gwo3 gei2 nin4 muk6 gung1 hok6 tou4

rows.note: Use this for an apprentice learning directly under a master, especially in a traditional craft or martial-arts setting.

example.english: Master Lee took me on as an apprentice and taught me Wing Chun himself every day.
example.traditional: 李師傅收咗我做徒弟，日日親自教我打詠春。
example.jyutping: lei5 si1 fu2 sau1 zo2 ngo5 zou6 tou4 dai2 jat6 jat6 can1 zi6 gaau3 ngo5 daa2 wing6 ceon1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when the master or employer takes someone on to learn a trade.

example.english: The shop is willing to apprentice me so I can learn to make leather shoes.
example.traditional: 間舖頭肯收我做徒弟，等我學識整皮鞋。
example.jyutping: gaan1 pou3 tau2 hang2 sau1 ngo5 zou6 tou4 dai2 dang2 ngo5 hok6 sik1 zing2 pei4 haai4

rows.traditional: 送 A 去跟 B 學師
rows.jyutping: sung3 A heoi3 gan1 B hok6 si1
rows.note: Use this when a parent or another person places someone under a particular master for training.

example.english: My dad sent me to apprentice under Master Chan to learn pastry-making.
example.traditional: 爸爸一早就送我去跟陳師傅學師，學整餅。
example.jyutping: baa1 baa1 jat1 zou2 zau6 sung3 ngo5 heoi3 gan1 can4 si1 fu6 hok6 si1 hok6 zing2 beng2
